recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a dead man's switch: `nightly-sync` pings a self-hosted monitor on the Synology (open-source Healthchecks or Uptime Kuma in Docker) at start and on failure, the monitor alerts if no ping arrives by 03:10, and central logging comes later.
note: The alert idea is right, but it is meant to run as a self-hosted Docker service on the Synology (Uptime Kuma or Healthchecks), so this is LARGER, and none of the four labelled lines appear.
